bundle.shortDescription: Terminal and remote-session manager for Linux
bundle.longDescription: PlexusTerm is a terminal and remote-session manager: local shells, SSH with jump hosts, an SFTP browser, SSH tunnels, serial consoles, split panes with multi-execution and saved sessions (with import from .ini session files).
